title: Spicy Ethiopian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Ethiopia, made with tender beef, aromatic spices, and a touch of nutty sweetness.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the stew and bring to a boil.
Return the beef to the pot and reduce the heat to low.
Simmer the stew for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the honey and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped nuts.
